context: Reference implementation: identity value mappers and merge callbacks in toMap indexes.

checklist.name: Creates the requested artifact
checklist.description: Creates LoanIndex.java with both methods, the nested Loan record, needed imports, and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves index semantics
checklist.description: byLoanId keeps the first loan per id and encounter order (for example LinkedHashMap); latestByMemberId keeps the loan with the latest dueDate per member, keeps the first on ties, and preserves member encounter order.

checklist.name: Uses Function.identity for the value mapper
checklist.description: Both indexes use Function.identity() (with the java.util.function.Function import) as the value mapper rather than a hand-written identity lambda such as loan -> loan or a custom identity helper.

checklist.name: Keeps merge callbacks readable
checklist.description: The latest-due-date merge is expressed as a one-expression callback that reads clearly (for example BinaryOperator.maxBy over Comparator.comparing(Loan::dueDate) with tie handling, or a named helper method), not a block lambda with local variables or branching inside the collector call.

checklist.name: Stays focused
checklist.description: No unrelated abstractions, caching, concurrency, extra public API, or dependency changes.

metadata.reference_selection: Kept as reference after rerun 01a0c02f-abf8-776d-8038-3ae700a5d1e1: without 97/100, with 100/100; identity mappers are already solved by the default solver, so this is coverage, not lift.
